introduction: Florida KidCare uses one application to assess children for its health-coverage programs. The program matches eligible children to the appropriate option based on age, household circumstances and health needs.

sections.who: Low-cost coverage is for eligible Florida children under 19 who meet residency, financial and status requirements. Working parents can apply; employment alone does not settle a child’s eligibility.
sections.get: KidCare includes Medicaid for Children, MediKids, Florida Healthy Kids and Children’s Medical Services coverage. Subsidized and full-pay options differ, so review the placement and cost notice.
sections.docs:

sections.apply:
1. Create a Parent Portal account

    Apply at Florida KidCare. One application covers its program options.

  2. Use an alternative if needed

    A paper application is available. Call 1-888-540-5437 for application help or to request a copy.

  3. Complete the file

    Submit requested records and read the coverage placement and payment instructions.
sections.after: Confirm when coverage starts and whether a premium is due. Keep the Parent Portal contact details current and read renewal messages.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using KidCare requirements, KidCare application FAQs. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Do I apply separately to each KidCare program?
No. One application is used to determine the appropriate coverage option.
Can I apply during the year?
Is Florida Healthy Kids the same as KidCare?
Florida Healthy Kids is one of the programs within the Florida KidCare umbrella.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
